at location.definition: B is a typical location where A can be found.

capable of.definition: Something that A can typically do is B.

causes.definition: A and B are events or actions, A typically causes B to happen.

cause desire.example: (having no food, CausesDesire, go to a store)

created by.definition: B is a process or agent that creates A.

defined as.definition: A and B overlap in meaning, B is a more explanatory version of A.

desires.definition: A is a conscious entity that typically wants B. Many assertions of this type use the word 'person' as A.

distinct from.definition: A and B are distinct members of a set; something that is A is not B. Symmetric.

has a.definition: B belongs to A, either as an inherent part or due to possession.

has subevent.definition: A and B are events, B happens as part of A.

has first subevent.definition: A is an event that begins with subevent B.

has last subevent.definition: A is an event that concludes with subevent B.

has prerequisite.definition: In order for A to happen, B needs to happen; B is a dependency of A.

has property.definition: A has B as one of its properties; A can be described as B.

manner of.definition: A is a specific way to do B. Similar to IsA but for verbs.

motivated by goal.definition: Someone does A because they want result B. A is a step toward accomplishing the goal B.

part of.definition: A is a part of B.

receives action.definition: B can be done to A.

used for.definition: A is used for B; the purpose of A is B.
